request.prompt: How many commercial humanoid robots exist?

result.text:
There is no single verified global count, because “commercial humanoid robots” can mean either commercially available robot models or physical robots already manufactured and deployed.

The distinction is important: dozens of humanoid robot models are being developed, but only a smaller number are actually being sold, rented, or used commercially.

Best available estimates (November 2026)

What is being counted?

Estimated number

Humanoid robot models identified worldwide

~284

Robots shipped cumulatively by June 2026

~35,000–41,000

Robots shipped during H1 2026 alone

22,000+

Robots sold for professional/industrial applications in 2025

~7,000

Verified large-scale commercial deployments

Much smaller; no reliable global unit count

Sources:

Leading commercial manufacturers

1. AGIBOT (China)

One of the largest manufacturers by shipment volume.

2. Unitree Robotics (China)

G1 and H1 humanoid robots; relatively affordable.

3. UBTECH (China)

Industrial humanoids for manufacturing.

4. Figure AI (USA)

Focused on autonomous factory and industrial work.

5. Agility Robotics (USA)

Digit robots for warehouses and logistics.

My assessment

If you mean physical humanoid robots that have been manufactured and shipped, the best current estimate is approximately 40,000 worldwide.

If you mean robots actually performing productive work for paying commercial customers, the number is substantially lower and is not reliably established. Many shipped units are still used for research, demonstrations, entertainment and AI training.

The distinction matters enormously when estimating the actual size of the humanoid robotics market.

## Best available estimates (November 2026)

| What is being counted? | Estimated number |
| --- | --- |
| Humanoid robot models identified worldwide | ~284 |
| Robots shipped cumulatively by June 2026 | ~35,000–41,000 |
| Robots shipped during H1 2026 alone | 22,000+ |
| Robots sold for professional/industrial applications in 2025 | ~7,000 |
| Verified large-scale commercial deployments | Much smaller; no reliable global unit count |
